title: Gabriel archangelus (Verdelot)
desc: Philippe Verdelot, Gabriel archangelus, before 1538. 4 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0040); edited by Vincent Besson, Kévin Roger, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
